outcome: Extension requests now converge before Professor review
owner_impact: Research AI sees a concise active-request catalog, reuses one request across papers when the scientific/model need is covered, records each blocked Experiment as evidence underneath that request, and Professor approval accepts the need into design without creating canonical capability truth.

next.text: Next is #360, which will make unsupported scientific tasks follow the durable blocked-Experiment closure path consistently for Student and Professor research AI. It has not started yet.

technical_evidence: The existing six request classes remain unchanged.
The capability-request interface is vlab.capability-request/5 with separate reuse and clearly-distinct-new-request inputs.
Active request discovery exposes only sanitized scientific/model identity and lifecycle fields.
Many closure analyses can link to one durable request through capability_request_evidence.
Professor triage no longer creates or binds canonical semantic capability identity.
The production-advisor follow-up adds the covering capability_request_evidence.linked_by index without changing request semantics.
